heading: INT. BACK ROOM OF A BAR - NIGHT

units.text: INT. BACK ROOM OF A BAR - NIGHT
low light, mismatched chairs. a long table. four people who have only ever typed to each other.
jonah kasprzak, 30s, in a faded army jacket, gets there first. he turns a phone over and over in his hand.
CLOSE ON the phone. a group chat. the name at the top reads: BRAVO 6 (reunion?).
odalys pierce, 40, walks in wearing scrubs and a heavy coat. she stops. looks at him.
you're boots.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: you're mama bear.
units.name: JONAH

units.text: yeah. oh my god. hi.
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: they hug, awkward, too long. behind them, tamsin, 20s, with a shaved head and a trembling duffel, hovers in the doorway.
is this the. is this where
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: yeah come in, come in
units.name: JONAH

units.text: okay. cool. i'm tams. i'm. yeah.
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: tams! the kid who sent the ramen pics
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: that was in basic. that was a long time ago
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: ANGLE ON the door. rafe oyelaran, 50, sixty pounds heavier than any photo, leans on a cane. nobody says anything.
well. don't everybody get up.
units.name: RAFE

units.text: sarge
units.name: JONAH

units.text: jonah. sit down. i'm not your sarge in a bar.
units.name: RAFE

units.text: rafe, you look
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: like hell. yes.
units.name: RAFE

units.text: everyone laughs, a little too hard. chairs scrape. nobody quite sits.
i didn't think i'd come. i almost didn't. i was in the car for like an hour
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: we all did that
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: i drove past twice
units.name: JONAH

units.text: three times.
units.name: RAFE

units.text: you were here?
units.name: JONAH

units.text: i was in the lot.
units.name: RAFE

units.text: this is the first time in nine years all four of them are in a room. none of them knows how to say what they mean.
so. who's ordering. because i need a drink and i need somebody to say something about the chat
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: the chat
units.name: TAMSIN

units.text: the thing in march
units.name: RAFE

units.text: we don't have to
units.name: JONAH

units.text: yes we do. jonah. that's the whole reason
units.name: ODALYS

units.text: a long pause. a glass clinks somewhere in the bar. tamsin sits first, then the others.
okay. so. i'll start
units.name: TAMSIN
